# Migration assessment flags
- Partner agreements, identifiers, delimiters, validation rules, certificates, and control-number sequencing require environment-specific configuration.
- Groovy logic is intentionally flagged for redesign.
- AS2 certificate material and credentials are not included.
- Exact native Boomi XML and deployment packaging are not asserted.
- 997/855/856/810 maps are representative definitions rather than executable Boomi maps.
